summary: Packing in ℂ^{ι × places}: distinct points are 1-apart in the sup norm.

steps.claim: Map a ∈ A to (Φ_v(f(a)_i))_{i,v} ∈ ℂ^{ι × places}. Distinct points are at sup-distance ≥ 1: otherwise every coordinate of f(a) − f(b), an algebraic integer, would have |Φ_v| < 1 everywhere and vanish (eq_zero_of_norm_Φ), contradicting injectivity. All points have norm ≤ r. By the packing bound (encard_le_of_separated with m = 1, R = r) #A ≤ (1 + 2r)^{dim_ℝ} with dim_ℝ = 2·|ι|·m.
steps.lean:
grw [encard_le_of_separated (f := fun x (i, v) ↦ Φ v (f x i)) _root_.one_pos o fun _ a _ b ↦ by
    simpa [← not_lt, pi_norm_lt_iff] using (j a b ∘ funext ∘ forall_imp fun _ ↦ eq_of_sub_eq_zero ∘
      eq_zero_of_norm_Φ (by grind [IsIntegral.sub])).mt] <;> simp_all [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg]
